data.title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
data.description: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.
